title: Google review evidence: twelve illustrative cases
creator: ReputationResolved
method: Author-coded desk research. Deliberately constructed examples distinguish observed facts, unsupported inferences and reporting routes. The examples are not a sample of businesses, actual customer cases, Google decisions or measured removal outcomes.

cases.title: No matching booking
cases.signal: The displayed name does not match the booking search.
cases.supported: That exact search found no matching record.
cases.not_established: That the account holder had no experience with the business.
cases.next_step: Record the search scope and check ordinary explanations privately, such as another booking name or a visit without a booking.

cases.title: A nickname on the review
cases.signal: The public display name is a nickname.
cases.supported: The public name may differ from a name used in business records.
cases.not_established: Impersonation, a fabricated account or a fabricated visit.
cases.next_step: Use the review link and the experience described as anchors, rather than treating the display name as a unique customer identifier.

cases.title: Stars without text
cases.signal: The contribution contains a star rating and no written account.
cases.supported: There is little public narrative to investigate.
cases.not_established: A policy violation merely because no text was supplied.
cases.next_step: Preserve the rating link and relevant context; do not invent a reason for removal from the missing text.

cases.title: Little visible account history
cases.signal: The reviewer has little publicly visible contribution history.
cases.supported: Few public contributions are visible to you.
cases.not_established: The person's account age, identity or lack of a genuine experience.
cases.next_step: Describe what is actually visible and separate it from assumptions about who operates the account.

cases.title: Several reviews close together
cases.signal: Several negative reviews appeared in a short period.
cases.supported: A cluster exists in the timestamps observed.
cases.not_established: That the reviews have the same author or are coordinated.
cases.next_step: Build a timestamped review list and look for independent corroboration before assigning an explanation.

cases.title: Repeated distinctive wording
cases.signal: Different accounts use the same distinctive passage.
cases.not_established: Who controls the accounts or that removal is certain.
cases.next_step: Keep exact links and side-by-side excerpts with dates; explain the pattern without identifying an operator you cannot verify.

cases.title: A documented competing interest
cases.signal: Reliable public material links the reviewer to an industry competitor.
cases.supported: A relationship relevant to a possible conflict can be documented.
cases.not_established: That an ordinary name resemblance proves that relationship.
cases.next_step: Preserve the source establishing the relationship and explain why it bears on this particular review.

cases.title: A different business is described
cases.signal: The review identifies another business or location and an experience inconsistent with this listing.
cases.supported: A specific mismatch between the text and the reviewed listing can be shown.
cases.not_established: That every unfamiliar service description is a wrong-business review.
cases.next_step: Identify the precise mismatch and preserve business/location context; avoid guessing solely from an unfamiliar name.

cases.title: Non-public personal details
cases.signal: The review exposes a person's non-public home address or private contact details.
cases.supported: Specific potentially private content can be identified.
cases.not_established: That an ordinary published business address is private personal information.
cases.next_step: Identify the concern privately and redact unnecessary details from general enquiries or public replies.

cases.title: A threat in the actual text
cases.signal: The review contains a direct threat of violence.
cases.supported: The threatening words and their context can be preserved.
cases.not_established: That severe criticism alone is a threat.
cases.next_step: Preserve the review and relevant context, prioritise immediate safety where needed and use the applicable reporting channel.

cases.title: A documented review incentive
cases.signal: A preserved offer links a payment, discount or benefit to posting, changing or removing a review.
cases.supported: The incentive and the review-related condition can be documented.
cases.not_established: That every refund or ordinary complaint resolution is a review incentive.
cases.next_step: Separate normal service resolution from the documented review condition; do not offer an incentive to obtain a deletion.

cases.title: A demand tied to removing attacks
cases.signal: A third party demands money or favours to remove suspicious negative reviews.
cases.supported: A potential extortion report can be supported by the actual demand and review links.
cases.not_established: That timing alone identifies the person behind every review.
cases.next_step: Preserve messages, timestamps and links; follow Google's dedicated merchant-extortion guidance rather than negotiating payment.
